labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Requests new unit-aware highlighting behavior in ReprHighlighter.

items.body:
Please first bring this proposal to Rich's Discussions for approval; feature requests need that before an issue. You can handle this in your application now by defining a custom `RegexHighlighter` for number and unit patterns and passing it to `Console`. See the [highlighting documentation](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/highlighting.rst).

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
